title: Surprising connections between DNA binding and function for the near-complete set of yeast transcription factors
authors: Lakshmi Mahendrawada; Linda Warfield; Rafal Donczew; Steven Hahn
one_liner_zh: 该文系统整合酵母转录因子结合与表达靶标数据，揭示TF结合与基因调控的非对应关系，但主要基于实验数据统计，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，属于广义TF-DNA互作的功能性研究，对本课题有背景参考价值。
abstract: DNA sequence-specific transcription factors (TFs) modulate transcription and chromatin architecture, acting from regulatory sites in enhancers and promoters of eukaryotic genes. How TFs locate their DNA targets and how multiple TFs cooperate to regulate individual genes is still unclear. Most yeast TFs are thought to regulate transcription via binding to upstream activating sequences, situated within a few hundred base pairs upstream of the regulated gene. While this model has been validated for individual TFs and specific genes, it has not been tested in a systematic way with the large set of yeast TFs. Here, we have integrated information on the binding and expression targets for the near-complete set of yeast TFs. While we found many instances of functional TF binding sites in upstream regulatory regions, we found many more instances that do not fit this model. In many cases, rapid TF depletion affects gene expression where there is no detectable binding of that TF to the upstream region of the affected gene. In addition, for most TFs, only a small fraction of bound TFs regulates the nearby gene, showing that TF binding does not automatically correspond to regulation of the linked gene. Finally, we found that only a small percentage of TFs are exclusively strong activators or repressors with most TFs having dual function. Overall, our comprehensive mapping of TF binding and regulatory targets have both confirmed known TF relationships and revealed surprising properties of TF function.
abstract_zh: DNA序列特异性转录因子（transcription factors, TFs）通过结合真核基因增强子和启动子中的调控位点，调节转录及染色质结构。TFs如何定位其DNA靶标以及多个TFs如何协同调控单个基因仍不清楚。大多数酵母TFs被认为通过结合上游激活序列（位于受调控基因上游数百碱基对范围内）来调节转录。尽管这一模型已在个别TFs和特定基因中得到验证，但尚未使用大量酵母TFs进行系统性测试。在此，我们整合了近完整酵母TFs集合的结合和表达靶标信息。虽然我们在上游调控区域发现了许多功能性TF结合位点的实例，但也发现了更多不符合此模型的实例。在许多情况下，快速耗竭TF会影响基因表达，而该TF在受影响基因的上游区域并无可检测的结合。此外，对于大多数TFs，仅有一小部分结合的TFs调控邻近基因，表明TF结合并不自动对应于连锁基因的调控。最后，我们发现仅少数TFs是纯粹的强激活子或抑制子，大多数TFs具有双重功能。总体而言，我们对TF结合和调控靶标的全面映射既确认了已知的TF关系，也揭示了TF功能的意外特性。
